title: Plato Berlin Office Visit
description: A visit to the new Berlin office of Plato, an AI startup founded by an ESCP alumnus, with a company presentation and an open discussion on the company's plans and internships.
fullDescription:
Our members visited Plato at its new Berlin office for an evening with the team. Plato is a Berlin based startup building an AI operating system, founded by an ESCP alumnus, and had recently raised a $14.5M seed round led by Atomico.
The evening began with a welcome from the co-founder, followed by a company presentation on Plato's vision, product and growth. The session then turned into an open discussion, where students learned about Plato's future plans, received practical career advice and heard what the team looks for in prospective interns. We would like to thank the Plato team for hosting us and for sharing their perspectives so openly.
